input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 already matches our preferred position. 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness-qualified) and never to a direct competitor; 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on Customer's change of control. 24.3 is expressly limited to "other assignments" and so does not swallow the 24.1 carve-out, and its consent standard is mutual and reasonableness-qualified. 13.3 aligns by permitting licence transfer with a Section 24 permitted assignment, and the only other assignment-related termination trigger (9.2 insolvency) carves out lawful reorganizations. No redline needed.
